scope: Candidate-only 2K color map for the existing V7 west wall. Keep its 1K normal/ARM, trim maps, geometry, UVs, collision and all lighting unchanged. Determine whether the visible improvement justifies the bounded texture memory increase.
source_mode: Same officially licensed source asset at its native 2K resolution; no AI upscale or invented detail.

mode_inference_decision.rationale: Opaque embedded base-color map; deterministic JPEG decode and WebP encode only.

gates: all geometry and collider buffer bytes unchanged
all material and sampler semantics unchanged
matched close and distant high/low actual-renderer captures
valid isolated GPU and normal gameplay measurements before publication
stop_rule: Do not publish a weak visual improvement, exceed the resource budget, invent new texels by upscaling, change the accepted UV layout, or treat invalid GPU results as a performance pass.
